title: Where can I generate a good game by just typing 10 words on Claude or ChatGPT?
author: JustAGirlInSpace2
selftext:
I see many anti-AI people saying that games made with AI are made without any effort, just ask chatgpt to create the game and done you generated a AI game! and if you try to do that you might even get a game, but a terrible, buggy, generic game without any soul, is not the AI good  games we see with good reviews in steam, is literally crap!  
  
You can also make crappy games without using AI, go to [itch.io](http://itch.io) or Unity, download a free game template, open it in the engine, export it to Windows, and publish it on Steam and that's it, depending on the situation it's faster than using AI and with no cost and this is crap too!  
  
Just because asset flippers are spamming terrible AI games made on Claude or ChatGPT on Steam doesn't mean that every game made with AI is bad.
